meta.title: Memory Recall
meta.description: Archives the earliest conversation context into memory/ folders as *pending* entries (no model call during archiving); the next request's system prompt gets a memory-scoring task section and the current session model submits α, trust β and keywords through the memory_judge tool in its own context — unscored memories are not recalled. Later matching memories are recalled by keyword with importance-weighted probability, with a per-memory β usage preamble; when the context exceeds the threshold again the oldest recalled entries are removed from the injected block and marked for re-review (no new folders are created). Restarts restore a v2 snapshot of the recalled block. Disabling the plugin unregisters the tool, the prompt sections and every listener. Since v1.3.0 it also supports two QQ channels (dsh-onebot-qq and Derpyu520/qq-bridge): automatic detection, one memory folder per stable chat key (a rebuilt session keeps its memory), an α floor for recalls triggered by non-owner group members, a reversible auto-patch of the Derpyu tool whitelist and a heuristic-scoring fallback; with neither plugin installed the behaviour is exactly 1.2.1.
